errors.text_span: Секторите изглеждат подредени по низходящ размер, започвайки от оранжевия сектор и завършвайки с жълтия.
errors.evidence: The description claims the sectors are arranged in descending order of size, but they are not. The sizes are 42.6% (orange), 23.5% (gray), 22.1% (blue), and 11.8% (yellow). The clockwise arrangement in the chart is blue, orange, gray, yellow, which is not a descending order of size.
